choices.content: Build it in any direction; the length is the same.
Build it in a direction parallel to \(l\).
Draw a perpendicular to \(l\) through point \(P\) and build along the perpendicular segment, because the perpendicular segment is the shortest.
Build it along the segment connecting \(P\) to any point on the riverbank.

question.prompt: How should the shortest canal from river \(l\) to village \(P\) be built?

solutions.explanation: Among the segments connecting a point outside a line to points on the line, the perpendicular segment is the shortest, so building the canal along the perpendicular segment gives the shortest canal.
solutions.title: Build along the perpendicular segment
